cases.name: Pamela Ann Williams
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Daughter of late Peggy Neal Mahone, she was a native of Williamson, WV, but had made her home in Gordon many years. Pam was a retired LPN from Central State Hospital. Accompanied in death by her husband of 52 years, Ricky Howard Williams."
